paragraphs.text:
TRIP A (from your Antarctica journal):
FEB. 1 — Small mountains surround this desolation. Even with 
the extended days, an air of gloom hangs over this range.
FEB. 6 — Blake appears disoriented, confused in his scientific 
activity. He radios to base camp for news of the other parties.
FEB. 7 — Incredible news! Rambeau’s group reports finding 
signs of buildings and civilization. Blake appears morose and 
edgy at the news. He orders Rambeau to return to base.
FEB. 8 — Can’t fly due to a whiteout. The storm is incredibly 
intense. Everyone is cold and miserable. Macpherson complains 
a great deal.
FEB. 10 — Able to fly at last!
FEB. 13 — Back at base camp. All communication from 
Rambeau’s group has been lost. Blake has decided to go in 
pursuit.
Now go to 574. 
(520)
